jsesh.graphics.bitmaps
Class StreamGraphics2DDelegate

java.lang.Object
  java.awt.Graphics
      java.awt.Graphics2D
          jsesh.graphics.generic.BaseGraphics2D
              jsesh.graphics.bitmaps.StreamGraphics2DDelegate
Direct Known Subclasses:
BitmapStreamGraphics
public abstract class StreamGraphics2DDelegate
extends BaseGraphics2D

A wrapper to encapsulate a "normal" Graphics2D in a StreamGraphics2D. Currently used for bitmaps.

Implementations should give a value to proxy.

Author:
rosmord

transform

public void transform(java.awt.geom.AffineTransform Tx)
Description copied from class: BaseGraphics2D
Transform the current system reference according to Tx.

All scaling and assorted transformations in BaseGraphics2D use this method. Hence, if you want to modify the transformation system, simply redefine it.
